description: Displayed outside the main building (warbirds.in 2009). Note warbirds.in also records Gnat E261 at HQ Maintenance Command Nagpur - one of the two paintings is spurious. The marking E261 is also worn by the Gnat at HQ Maintenance Command Nagpur, which has the documented ex-2 Sqn provenance; tail left blank here and the painted serial kept as an alias.
